  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The other-repository guard skips the check when `CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE` cannot capture the value after `--repo`/`-R`, so the step stays a same-repository `credentials` step. Values it cannot capture include a backtick-quoted value, a placeholder such as `<owner>/<consumer-app>`, and a variable such as `$TARGET`; for these `findall` returns `[]` and `any([])` is False.
  WHY: `_check_credentials` returns `met` from this repository's own recent successful `review_autofix.yml` run, the done marker is posted, and `_close_tracker_when_done` can close the `ai:operator-step` tracker although the other repository's secret was never set. This contradicts the "Fails closed" comment at line 807. No other guard (`CREDENTIAL_HANDOFF_RE`, `UPPER_SNAKE_RE`, `HUMAN_OBJECT_TITLE_RE` or the object-word loop) catches these shapes. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:744,805-808 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE` captures a prefix with no argument-boundary check. With `--repo "o/r"-other`, the optional `[\"']?` consumes the opening quote and the capture stops at the closing quote, giving `o/r`, while the shell argument is `o/r-other`.
  WHY: When the repo under review is `o/r` (or `acme/app` vs `acme/app-other`), a step for a different repository passes the same-repository comparison and is ticked from this repository's own run, and the tracker can close. minimax calls this a regression from the old regex. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to adopt this finding as unrealistic (see its per-reviewer note). Every reviewer that flagged it rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:747,808-809 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_FLAG_RE` covers `--org`/`--repos`/`--env`/`-o`/`-e` but misses the `gh secret set` targets `--app`/`-a` (dependabot, codespaces) and `--user`/`-u` (user secrets).
  WHY: `gh secret set GH_PAT --app dependabot` is classified as `credentials` and ticked because the existing Actions secret has a recent successful run, although the Dependabot or user secret was never set. Severities disagree: minimax rated it MAJOR, the other three rated it NIT; the highest is used.

The handoff and repository guards are also missing from the docstring.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but operator-facing documentation now disagrees with the code and with the agents.d and changelog.d fragments. All flaggers rated it NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE at line 744 (`(?:--repo|-R)(?:\s+|=)[\"']?([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)`), used in `_observable_condition` at lines 805-808 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The other-repository guard is skipped when `findall` captures nothing after `--repo`/`-R`. Examples are a backtick-quoted value, a placeholder `<owner>/<consumer-app>`, and `$TARGET`. `any([])` is then False, so the step is classified as a same-repository `credentials` step, and no other guard catches a placeholder. The last run fixed only the `"`/`'` quote case.
  WHY: For "Add GH_PAT" with `gh secret set GH_PAT --repo <owner>/<consumer-app>`, `_observable_condition` returns `("credentials", [])` and `_check_credentials` returns `met` from this repository's own `review_autofix.yml` run. `tick` posts the done marker and `_close_tracker_when_done` can close the tracker. Suggested fix: return None when the count of `--repo`/`-R` flags differs from the count of slug captures, plus one test row.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_FLAG_RE at line 747 (`(?:--(?:org|repos|env)|-[oe])(?:\s|=)`), checked at line 809 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The scope-flag guard does not cover the `--app`/`-a` (dependabot, codespaces) or `--user`/`-u` secret targets.
  WHY: `gh secret set GH_PAT --app dependabot` is ticked because the Actions secret has a recent successful run. Suggested fix: `--(?:org|repos|env|app|user)|-[oeau]` plus one test row.
- README.md:line 3126, `OPERATOR_STEP_DAILY_TICK_ENABLED` row; also the module docstring in scripts/operator_step_issue.py, lines 82-86 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README row does not mention organisation or environment secrets, and the docstring does not describe the handoff, repository or scope guards. Only the agents.d and changelog.d fragments were updated.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the docs disagree with the code and the fragments.
- NOTE: The reviewer did not adopt the `--repo "o/r"-other` finding: it needs a quote inside a shell word, and an unquoted `o/r-other` is captured whole. The reviewer also says `--repo "$CONSUMER_REPO"` is already caught by `UPPER_SNAKE_RE`.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): the `--repo` flag/capture count check after line 808 (3 lines), and widening `CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_FLAG_RE` at line 747 (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

  WHY: The check returns `met` from `OBSERVABLE_CREDENTIAL_WORKFLOWS`, the done marker is posted, and the tracker can close although the Dependabot or user secret was never set. The test parametrisation already lists the existing flags, so the list is known to be incomplete.
